name: Hayami Taiyou
source: Hayami Taiyou is a diligent and respected leader in Makoto Advanced Academy. His calm and collected demeanor grants him plenty respect as an authority figure, however his perverted and whimsical thoughts herald in a plethora of unfortunate consequences for this protagonist.
